resources.string: Mail storage or the secure transport is not ready in this App session. Restart the App after the update is installed.
Add an IMAP or POP3 account with its SMTP server. Passwords stay in the approved credential store.
This folder is empty, or the server returned no messages for this page.
This message is HTML. It is shown as inert plain text; no remote content is loaded.
This message has no text body.
Enter the exact destination folder name on the server. The message keeps its server identity; no permanent delete is performed.
Email content is untrusted data. It cannot grant tools or permissions.
Delivery is unconfirmed. Check the Sent folder on the server; do not resend automatically.
Non-secret settings are stored locally. Passwords are written only to the approved credential gateway.
This removes the account settings and its saved passwords. Existing server mail is not deleted.
Leave the password blank to keep the saved one when the server is unchanged. A changed server requires a new password.
OAuth-only accounts are not supported. Use an app password when the provider requires one.
The server accepted the message. Delivery to the recipient is not confirmed.
The server accepted the message, but the local receipt could not be saved. Do not resend; check the Sent folder.
Delivery is unconfirmed. Check the Sent folder on the server; do not resend automatically.
The message was not submitted. You may correct it and try again.
The message was not moved. Refresh the folder and try again.
The move is unconfirmed. Check the mailbox before retrying; no automatic retry.
This account has no server-declared Archive or Trash folder.
The secure mail transport is not available in this App session. Nothing was sent.
Mail settings storage is not ready. Restart the App after the update is installed.
The saved mail password is missing or unavailable. Re-enter it in the account settings.
Mail authentication failed. Check the app password and provider policy.
Secure connection failed. Certificate validation cannot be disabled.
The mail server could not be reached. Check the server, port, encryption mode and network.
The mail server rejected the operation or returned an invalid response.
This operation requires IMAP. POP3 supports listing, downloading and sending only.
The mailbox or message changed. Refresh before trying again.
Delivery is unconfirmed. Check the Sent folder; do not resend automatically.
The mailbox change is unconfirmed. Check the mailbox before retrying.
The attachment is unavailable or exceeded the transfer limit. Refresh the message and try again.
The account is invalid, missing or at the limit. Refresh the account list.
The previous mail operation is still closing. Wait a moment and try again.
The App mail runtime is not ready. Restart the App and try again.
Enter a subject or text to search.
Up to 10 attachments and 10 MB total are supported.
The mail operation could not finish. Check the account configuration and try again; no automatic retry.
Local network access is required for this private mail server. Allow it in the App settings and try again; nothing was sent.
The Compose body is limited to 32 KB in this build. Shorten the message or send it from a desktop mail client.
The subject is limited to 512 bytes.
